Parameters ---------- user_name : str The user's full name. biography : str A multi-sentence biography provided by the user. status : str A brief, current status update from the user. Returns ------- str The sanitized and formatted HTML string ready to be embedded in a web page. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (user_name, biography, status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
